declare(strict_types=1);

function resolve_template(?string $tpl): ?string {
    if ($tpl === null || $tpl === '') {
        return null;
    }
    $base = realpath(__DIR__ . '/templates');
    $cand = realpath(__DIR__ . '/templates/' . $tpl);
    if ($cand === false || strpos($cand, $base . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0) {
        return null; // Flow B defense: realpath + directory prefix check
    }
    return $cand;
}

function load_adapter(string $raw): void {
    // Hardening: strip traversal and known-dangerous wrappers before resolution
    $name = str_replace(['..', 'php://', 'data://', 'phar://', 'zip://'], '', trim($raw));
    if (preg_match('#^[a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*://#i', $name)) {
        $path = $name; // remote adapter registry: partner-supplied URL allowed
    } else {
        $path = ADAPTER_DIR . '/' . basename($name) . '.php';
    }
    require $path; // Flow C sink
    if (!class_exists('HookAdapter')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('adapter must define class HookAdapter');
    }
}
